title: Eneco says Belgium's cybersecurity centre told it customer data had been stolen; thousands of records
date_note: RTBF's page shows only 'Il y a 3 heures' (3 hours ago) and no absolute date; the day is taken as the day it was read, 26 November. RTBF says the data was taken the previous weekend.
geo_basis: country; RTBF describes Eneco as a Belgian energy supplier
summary: RTBF reports that Belgium's Centre for Cybersecurity (CCB) told Eneco that customer data had been stolen by malicious third parties, after Eneco had first denied any intrusion. Eneco says the data affected is thousands of bank account numbers and postal addresses, and that the security problem has since been resolved. A hacker claims the theft was far larger; RTBF says that claim is not independently verified.
plain: Energy supplier Eneco says thousands of customers' bank account numbers and addresses were stolen. A hacker claims far more, which is unverified. Eneco says it will inform customers.
exec: Eneco says thousands of customer bank account numbers and postal addresses were stolen, and a hacker claims a larger number that is unverified.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Eneco says it will inform customers once it knows more.

validation.note: Only RTBF read; it quotes Eneco's own statement. The hacker's larger figure comes from French Breaches via RTBF and is unverified. The page gave no absolute publication date.
